methods.label: Ranged Wilderness kill
methods.summary: Use ranged or Wilderness weapons against Chaos Elemental while keeping escape options ready.
recommendedFor: players using Webweaver or Craw's bow
steps: Bring low-risk ranged gear and a teleport plan for deep Wilderness.
Keep inventory spaces filled with food or supplies to limit item unequip effects.
Attack with ranged while watching for player-killers.
Bank valuable drops rather than extending too long.
risks: The Chaos Elemental can unequip items if inventory space is open.
Deep Wilderness deaths can lose carried gear and loot.

methods.label: Safespot or melee alternative
methods.summary: Use terrain or melee Wilderness weapons when choosing a lower-supply alternative to direct ranged kills.
steps: Use known terrain to reduce incoming damage where possible.
With melee, stay ready to eat through unpredictable special effects.
Keep inventory filled so unequip attacks are less disruptive.
notes: Magic is not the preferred strategy despite some data weaknesses.
